context: Ren and Asuka discuss a startup's pivot.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: research discussion; vocabulary (意思/転換/初期/試み/勝ち) in natural home.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: あの会社、方向を転換したんですね。
lines.style: engaged young student voice, soft warm curious throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 創業者の強い意思が、あったんでしょう。
lines.en: The founder must have had strong will.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 初期は、苦しかったみたいです。
lines.en: The early days seem to have been hard.
lines.style: thoughtful young student voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 初期の試みは、たいてい難しいものです。
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 何度も試みて、勝ちを掴んだんですね。
lines.en: They tried many times and grasped victory.
lines.style: admiring young student voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 意思の強さが、勝ちを呼びます。
lines.en: Strength of will calls forth victory.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 転換の決断、見習いたいです。
lines.en: I want to emulate that decision to pivot.
lines.style: resolved young student voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 初期の試みを、恐れないことですね。
lines.en: It's about not fearing early attempts.
lines.style: warm teacher voice, soft warm measured closing clarity throughout
